confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are rough: web sources for Ushuaia conflicted widely and many were dated, AI-generated, or outdated, so values are bounded estimates. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not checked against live listings. The FX value came from a third-party aggregator that attributed it to the RBA; I did not verify it on rba.gov.au, the source_url is the RBA's canonical exchange-rates page, and the observation is about three weeks older than the generation date. Cocktail and wine anchors rely on the local price relationship to beer because direct data was thin.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Ushuaia-specific search snippets (Expatistan, CityCost, Almurakib, Championtraveler) and general knowledge of Patagonian tourist towns, which are priced higher than the rest of Argentina because goods are imported. Cocktails were set at roughly 2.5 times the beer anchor and wine at roughly the beer anchor, reflecting thin direct data. Accommodation reflects general knowledge of July low-season tourist pricing in Ushuaia.
